practice.title: Shape sprint
practice.description: Earn 500 score in 90 seconds. One life, no enemy tanks.
practice.tip: Keep moving and choose a useful upgrade at level 15.

practice.title: Drone drill
practice.description: Earn 1,500 score with an Overlord in two minutes.
practice.tip: Hold fire to guide drones. Right click recalls them.

practice.title: Skirmish
practice.description: Destroy three tanks in three minutes. Everyone starts at level 30.
practice.tip: Use cover, watch your health, and spend your skill points.

practice.title: Last stand
practice.description: Survive two minutes or be the last tank standing as the arena closes.
practice.tip: Farm early and keep an escape route toward the center.

practice.title: Counter school
practice.description: Counter three rushers in two minutes with the Counterguard.
practice.tip: Time the ability just before a Smasher touches your hull. A counter removes half its health.

practice.title: Frozen front
practice.description: Win four duels in three minutes with the Chronarch.
practice.tip: Catch a volley, move the field toward your opponent, and let the outward wave do the work.

practice.title: Sentinel hunt
practice.description: Defeat the Sentinel in four minutes. One life, a complete Reprisal build.
practice.tip: Watch the boss's white warning ring. Parry the heavy shots and dodge the second attack.

practice.title: Hold the line
practice.description: Stop three rushers in three minutes with the Triple Trapper.
practice.tip: Build a field before engaging. Your tougher traps protect several approaches at once.

practice.title: Break the siege
practice.description: Defeat the Siege Engine in four minutes with a complete Reprisal build.
practice.tip: The gun locks its aim before firing. Cross the warning lanes, then counterattack while it recovers.

practice.title: Cut off the skirmisher
practice.description: Defeat the Skirmisher in three minutes with the Gunner.
practice.tip: Lead its orbit. After its warning it charges straight ahead; move sideways instead of backing away.

practice.title: Clear the minefield
practice.description: Defeat the Trapper in four minutes with the Triple Trapper.
practice.tip: Keep the forward lane open. Its special attack lays mines at the sides, leaving a path through the center.

controls: M or the bottom-right microphone button
Left / Right or spectator buttons, while dead
Enter while alive, or Slash, on community servers
Hold Shift while pressing its key or clicking
F1, or Help in the HUD
Restart an offline game from pause
F6, then 1 through 4 to start a challenge
PgUp / PgDn; hold Shift for 15 levels
